answer.rationale: Contract ends in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line is at 94% with no buffer, so deferral (c5) risks a supply gap and is not analogous to a non-critical month-to-month continuation. Switching primary (c2) or standing up a second source (c3) in this window would raise delivery risk even if onboarding was once described as quick. Incumbent continuity (c1) protects integration and deliveries; the cost mandate is better pursued by benchmarking and renegotiating at this renewal (c4), possibly via a longer commitment for volume pricing (c6). Whether that reaches 18% is unverified, so this is a commercial push not a vendor change or a broad operational rollout.
